title: 第5章 坑已挖好第6章 鬼迷心窍
content_zh:
按照云极的打算，先卖了熊烈积攒一笔灵石，然后在借据里选个数额最高的先还掉，如此一来，其他债主潜意识里会觉得落云山庄有还债的能力，不会催得太急，足以拖一阵子。
不还最急的，只还最多的，这是一种心理暗示，证明我云家还有实力。
没想到第一个登门的债主是程舀，这家伙不是来要债，而是来要山庄的。
落云山庄的地契价值一万灵石，钱已经输没了，人家来收房理所应当。
没了山庄，相当于没了落脚地，云极倒是不在乎，自己有的是办法东山再起，但是一大家子人呢，总不能拖家带口的流落街头。
吩咐一句有请，云极在记忆里提取出债主的信息。
程舀，筑基中期修士，天石城龙虎镖局总镖头。
落云山庄位于北燕国天石县，毗邻天石城，龙虎镖局是天石城最大的镖局。
修行界也有镖局，还不少，并非什么奇闻。
起初云极也不理解。
毕竟修行者有储物袋可随身携带，东西装里就走，方便快捷，镖局这种古老的营生早该淘汰才对。
后来得知储物袋的价格与空间后，云极就理解了。
最便宜的储物袋至少数千灵石，低阶修士根本买不起，里面的空间极其有限，也就一个小箱子那么大，类似个大书包。
这么点空间，装些随身携带的丹药灵石足够，想要运送大量货物是不可能的。
于是镖局的作用就体现而出，可以雇佣镖师，将货物安全送达目的地。
在天石县，龙虎镖局的名头相当响亮，身为总镖头的程舀也算一方人物，落云山庄经常需要运送矿石与灵材，大多会选择与飞龙镖局合作。
简短的了解过后，云极对阮青瑶说道：
“等会儿阿璃帮姐夫做盘菜，最后端上来，做得好吃的话，落云山庄就能保住了。”
说罢在小丫头耳畔低语几句，详细吩咐了菜品。
云极说得轻松，可听在阮青璃耳中则是一个重要的任务，事关山庄的大事。

阮青璃眨了眨明眸，郑重的点点头，整个人都显得紧张起来，急忙下去准备。
这时程舀的身影迈入大厅。
此人三十多岁的年纪，身形健硕，声音洪亮：
“一月未见，少庄主气色不错啊哈哈！”
云极起身相迎，面带微笑道：“程总镖头别来无恙，快屋里请。”
“刚好有笔生意，路过这边顺便来瞧瞧。”
程舀自从进门就四下打量，频频点头道：“桌子不错，上百年的梨花木，屏风也好，深海珊瑚做的，百年古宅果然有底蕴，就是上梁有点斜，还得找人修缮一番。”
看似在说屋子构造，实际在暗讽云家上梁不正下梁歪，出了个极品赌狗，上一辈自然也不是什么好东西。
云极听得出对方话语中的揶揄之意，淡然一笑，心情不错。
就喜欢这种有点小心机，还忍不住经常卖弄的家伙，如果是个愣头青或者心机深沉之辈，反而不好对付。
坑已经挖好，就看对方一会儿跳不跳。
“幸好总镖头提醒，我都没注意房梁歪了，明儿让下人修补一下。”
云极轻描淡写的继续说道：“其实屏风也该换了，样式太闷，看着死气沉沉，听说天石城的朱氏家具行出了款新屏风，琉璃石打造，不知要价几何。”
程舀家里不久前刚买了那款屏风，顺着接话道：
“朱老三那个黑心鬼要价六百灵石！想钱想疯了他，磨了他三天才降了一百，最后五百灵石买的，还别说，东西真不错，有淡淡的灵气覆盖大厅，看着就养眼。”
“要六百灵石？”云极听罢蹙起眉峰。
程舀一看顿时优越感爆棚，老子随便出手就能买得起一块屏风，你小子不行了吧。
正要添油加醋夸一夸琉璃屏风如何美妙，就听云极开口道：
content_en:
According to Yunji's plan, he first sold Xiong Lie to accumulate a sum of spiritual stones, and then chose the one with the highest amount in the IOU to repay first. In this way, other creditors would subconsciously feel that Luoyun Villa has the ability to repay the debt, and would not push it too hastily, enough to delay it for a while.
Not repaying the most urgent, but only repaying the most. This is a psychological hint, proving that my Yun family still has strength.
Unexpectedly, the first creditor who came to the door was Cheng Bao. This guy came not to ask for a debt, but to ask for the villa.
The land deed of Luoyun Villa is worth 10,000 spiritual stones. The money has been lost, so it is natural for people to come to collect the house.
Without the villa, it was equivalent to losing a place to stay. Yunji didn't care. He had plenty of ways to make a comeback, but a large family couldn't live on the streets with their families.
With a request, Yunji retrieved the creditor's information from his memory.
Cheng Bao, a monk in the middle stage of foundation building, is the chief escort of Longhu Escort Bureau in Tianshi City.
Luoyun Villa is located in Tianshi County, Beiyan State, adjacent to Tianshi City. Longhu Escort Bureau is the largest escort agency in Tianshi City.
There are also quite a few escort agencies in the spiritual world, which is not a strange thing.
Yunji didn't understand it at first.
After all, practitioners have storage bags that they can carry with them, and they can just put things in and go, which is convenient and fast. The ancient business of escort agencies should have been eliminated long ago.
Later, when he learned about the price and space of the storage bag, Yunji understood.
The cheapest storage bag costs at least several thousand spirit stones, and low-level monks cannot afford it. The space inside is extremely limited, and is only as big as a small box, similar to a large school bag.
With such a small amount of space, it is enough to carry some elixirs and spiritual stones with you, but it is impossible to transport a large amount of goods.
So the role of the escort agency comes into play, you can hire escorts to deliver the goods safely to the destination.
In Tianshi County, the Dragon Tiger Escort Bureau is quite famous, and as the chief escort chief, Cheng Bo is also considered a figure. Luoyun Villa often needs to transport ores and spiritual materials, so most of them will choose to cooperate with the Feilong Escort Agency.
After a brief understanding, Yunji said to Ruan Qingyao:
"Ali will help brother-in-law prepare the dishes later and serve them at the end. If they are delicious, Luoyun Villa can be saved."
After that, he whispered a few words into the little girl's ear and ordered the dishes in detail.
Yunji said it easily, but in Ruan Qingli's ears, it was an important task, related to the major affairs of the villa.
Ruan Qingli blinked her bright eyes and nodded solemnly. Her whole body seemed nervous and she hurried down to prepare.
At this time, Cheng Lao's figure entered the hall.
This man is in his thirties, with a strong build and a loud voice:
"I haven't seen you for a month, the young village master looks good, haha!"
Yun Ji stood up to greet him, and said with a smile: "Mr. Cheng, escort chief, you are fine. Please come to the house."
"I happened to have some business, so I stopped by to take a look."
Cheng Lao looked around since he entered the house, nodded frequently and said, "The table is good, it is made of pear wood that is hundreds of years old, and the screen is also good, made of deep-sea coral. The century-old house really has its heritage, but the upper beam is a bit skewed, and we need to find someone to repair it."
It seems to be talking about the structure of the house, but in fact it is insinuating that the upper beams of the Yun family are not straight and the lower beams are crooked. They have a top gambling dog, and the previous generation is naturally not a good person.
Yunji could hear the teasing tone in the other person's words, and smiled lightly, feeling in a good mood.
I like this kind of guy who is a bit cautious and can't help but show off all the time. If he is a fool or a scheming person, it will be difficult to deal with him.
The hole has been dug, it just depends on whether the other party will jump or not.
"Fortunately, the chief escort reminded me that I didn't even notice that the beam was crooked. I'll have my servants repair it tomorrow."
Yun Ji continued in an understatement: "Actually, the screen should be replaced. The style is too boring and looks lifeless. I heard that Zhu's Furniture Store in Tianshi City has a new screen, made of glazed stone. I don't know how much the asking price is."
Cheng Bo's family just bought that screen not long ago, and he followed the words:
"That black-hearted man Zhu Laosan asked for six hundred spirit stones! He was driven crazy by his desire for money, and he was tortured for three times.The genius dropped by 100, and I bought it for the last 500 spirit stones. Not to mention, the stuff is really good. There is a faint aura covering the hall, which is eye-catching to look at. "
"You want six hundred spirit stones? "Yunji frowned after hearing this.
Cheng Bao felt a sense of superiority when he saw it. I can afford a screen at will, but you can't do that.
Just as he was about to add some extra flair to praise the beauty of the glazed screen, he heard Yun Ji say:
